rationale: The agent used get_files_info once to confirm the target file exists, then two targeted get_file_content calls with specific line ranges (more efficient than full file reads) to first retrieve a middle section of the file (which revealed the total line count) then read the end of the file where calculate_shipping_cost resides. All tool calls had clear purposes toward the task, no redundant calls were made, and the minor 15-line overlap between the two file reads was incidental to retrieving the needed end-of-file content.
